title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 359 (Appointment of Official Liquidator)

content.overview: For the purposes of this Act, so far as it relates to the winding up of companies by the Tribunal, the Central Government may appoint as many Official Liquidators, Joint Official Liquidators, Deputy Official Liquidators and Assistant Official Liquidators as it may consider necessary. The liquidators so appointed shall be whole-time officers of the Central Government. The Central Government may also appoint, for a limited time and for a specified purpose, Official Liquidators from a panel of professionals maintained by it.
content.glance: Central Government may appoint Official Liquidators (and Joint/Deputy/Assistant) as whole-time officers, and may also appoint panel professionals for limited time and specified purpose.
content.study: Section 359 provides for the appointment of Official Liquidators for Tribunal winding up. The Central Government may appoint as many Official Liquidators, Joint, Deputy and Assistant Official Liquidators as it considers necessary; those appointees are whole-time officers of the Central Government. The Central Government may also appoint Official Liquidators from a panel of professionals for a limited time and for a specified purpose.

sections.heading: Appointment
sections.body: Central Government appoints Official Liquidators (and Joint/Deputy/Assistant) as whole-time officers; panel professionals may be appointed for limited time and specified purpose.

examples.title: Panel appointment
examples.body: For a complex asset realisation, the Central Government appoints a panel professional as Official Liquidator for a limited period under s. 359.

hypotheticals.question: Must every Official Liquidator be a whole-time government officer?
hypotheticals.analysis: Whole-time officers are the primary route; the Central Government may also appoint panel professionals for a limited time and specified purpose.

misconceptions.trap: Only practising professionals may be Official Liquidators.
misconceptions.correction: The primary route is whole-time Central Government officers; panel professionals may be appointed for limited/specified purposes.
